mapper.select: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.WRITER_NO, P.CATEGORY_ID, P.TRADE_TYPE, P.TITLE, DESCRIPTION, PRICE, P.PRODUCT_CONDITION, P.AUCTION_START_PRICE, P.AUCTION_END_TIME, P.IS_DIRECT, P.TRADE_LOCATION, P.STATUS, P.VIEW_COUNT, P.CREATED_AT, P.UPDATED_AT, P.IS_DELETED, TO_CHAR(AUCTION_END_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS AUCTION_END_TIME_STR, TO_CHAR(P.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_AT_STR, TO_CHAR(P.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATED_AT_STR, case when U.IS_DELETED = 1 then '탈퇴한 회원' else U.NICKNAME end as WRITER_NICKNAME FROM PRODUCTS P LEFT JOIN USERS U ON P.WRITER_NO = U.USER_NO WHERE product_id = #{productId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCTS P LEFT JOIN USERS U ON P.WRITER_NO = U.USER_NO

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.WRITER_NO, P.CATEGORY_ID, P.TRADE_TYPE, P.TITLE, P.DESCRIPTION, P.PRICE, P.PRODUCT_CONDITION, P.AUCTION_START_PRICE, P.AUCTION_END_TIME, P.IS_DIRECT, P.TRADE_LOCATION, P.STATUS, P.VIEW_COUNT, P.CREATED_AT, P.UPDATED_AT, P.IS_DELETED, TO_CHAR(P.AUCTION_END_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS AUCTION_END_TIME_STR, TO_CHAR(P.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_AT_STR, TO_CHAR(P.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATED_AT_STR, case when U.IS_DELETED = 1 then '탈퇴한 회원' else U.NICKNAME end as WRITER_NICKNAME, C.CATEGORY_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME FROM PRODUCTS P LEFT JOIN USERS U ON P.WRITER_NO = U.USER_NO LEFT JOIN CATEGORIES C ON P.CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID
ORDER BY
P.PRICE ASC, P.PRODUCT_ID DESC
P.PRICE DESC, P.PRODUCT_ID DESC
P.VIEW_COUNT DESC, P.PRODUCT_ID DESC
P.PRODUCT_ID DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCTS (writer_no, category_id, trade_type, title, description, price, product_condition, auction_start_price, trade_location, auction_end_time) VALUES (#{writerNo}, #{categoryId}, #{tradeType}, #{title}, #{description}, #{price}, #{productCondition}, #{auctionStartPrice}, #{tradeLocation}, #{auctionEndTime})
INSERT INTO PRODUCT_MEDIA ( product_id, media_type, media_url, thumbnail_url, media_order ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{mediaType}, #{mediaUrl}, #{thumbnailUrl}, #{mediaOrder} )
mapper.select: SELECT media_id, product_id, media_type, media_url, thumbnail_url, media_order FROM PRODUCT_MEDIA WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY media_order
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCTS SET CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}, TITLE = #{title}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, PRODUCT_CONDITION = #{productCondition}, AUCTION_START_PRICE = #{auctionStartPrice}, AUCTION_END_TIME = #{auctionEndTime}, IS_DIRECT = #{isDirect}, TRADE_LOCATION = #{tradeLocation}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}

UPDATE PRODUCTS SET CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}, TITLE = #{title}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, PRODUCT_CONDITION = #{productCondition}, PRICE = #{price}, IS_DIRECT = #{isDirect}, TRADE_LOCATION = #{tradeLocation}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
